To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have crystallized and determined the X-ray structure of a protein involved in the immunity system of enterocins A and C, which are produced by the bacteriocin-producing strain Enterococcus mundtii 14.
the crystals of the enterocin A protein are suitable for high-resolution structural analysis.
Crystals of the enterocin A (Ea) immunity protein have been obtained by hanging-drop vapour diffusion.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the structural elucidation of a novel immunity protein, the enterocin A (Eca) immunity protein.
the development of novel antibacterial peptides and their use as potential therapeutics.

the structural and functional characterization of the enterocin A (EntA) immunity protein (EntAIP) from Lactococcus lactis, which is a member of the class of bacteriocins called pediocin-like bacteriocins (PLB).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the enterocin A immune protein crystals are monoclinic, space group C2, with unit-cell dimensions a = 116 A, b = 41 A, c = 65 A, beta =111 degrees, with one dimer in the unit cell, with a molecular weight for each subunit of 12 kDa.
enterocin A is a 36-residue polypeptide that is produced by the Gram-positive bacterium Enterococcus faecalis and that the immunity protein is a 98-residue protein.
the crystal belongs to the C2 space group and that the asymmetric unit contains two protein molecules.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the enterocin A system has been crystallized and the crystals have been characterized in terms of unit-cell parameters and crystal packing.
we have successfully prepared and crystallized the immunity protein from enterocin A.
the enterocin A protein has been crystallized, the crystal structure has been solved and the crystal structure has provided a model for the enterocin receptor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
enterocin A is an effective antimicrobial peptide that can be used in food preservation and in the treatment of infections.

the crystal packing is not dominated by hydrophobic contacts and the protein molecules do not interact via extensive intermolecular hydrogen bonds, which may explain why the protein crystallizes so readily in different crystal systems and space groups.
the enterocin A system is a promising target for further structural and functional studies, as the crystal structure determination is feasible.
